name: productboard
label: Productboard
description: Product management: read features, products and customer feedback; file, tag, attribute and link feedback and mark it processed; create and update features.

versions.notes: Six actions for finishing the triage of a note: update_note (processed, tags, owner), set_note_customer, unlink_note, create_entity, get_entity_type and get_note_fields (benjaminLedel/covey-plugin-pack#88). Without update_note the poll on unprocessed notes woke the agent again for every note it had handled. The writing actions are written from the API v2 reference; the requests they produce were checked against covey's manifest engine, not yet against a live workspace.

First release, for Productboard's API v2. The list actions filter and paginate through the query, which a covey before 0.13.0 drops (benjaminLedel/covey#601). Read actions, probe and poll exercised against a live workspace; the three writing actions are written from the API reference.
